posts.subject: Knife server player models
posts.bodyHtml:
I was wondering that there are masks added that there are chances of adding custom player models from game like quake 3 arena as I have noticed someone of them are nice and wondered if there are chances of adding some of them and if there was a chance of adding them they should not be cheap and should be for over 10/20K credits I have listed them below.


Bones [Bild] <---- Comes in different colours



Phobos [Bild]



Doom [Bild]


Uriel [Bild]


Crash[Bild]

There is a ongoing discussion about player models for our servers.
And ofc there aren't only advantages but the downsides of more downloadcontent and stuff.
We haven't decided yet but @Sky need to be convinced to add it to our servers.
Stay expectant and if there are any changes you'll notice them in here [(:]

I personally really detest the idea of changing character models. For me, it completely ruins the pure CS:GO feel for me as I'm not knifing another CT/T but instead, some goon running around.


And Wickedy is right, as if there isn't enough downloadable content now (items from store), adding more will just simply make the server lag more and make it frustrating to play at since there's weird stuff flying around you (rainbow trail, pets) and increase the probability of ghost hits (hitting a person but no response even you heard the sound and saw the motion).


In my honest opinion, pets, trials and masks are already pushing those things to the limit, adding character models for me, is just beyond a joke.


~ Doo Doo

Bad idea for my part, It will not be CS GO anymore..
